description: Berry palette for the retailer storefront's marketing surfaces only (home hero, promotional banners and their carousel chrome). These tokens are intentionally NOT part of design/tokens.json: the shared platform registry bans saturated pink/red branding, and the owner approved berry for marketing surfaces alone. The generated CSS is exempted, by exact filename, from the prohibited-colour audit; tests assert parity with this file and restrict marketing-* utilities to the allowlisted components.

berry.description: Berry brand accent for storefront marketing. 600 is the action stop; 800 is for headings on pale berry surfaces.

ink.description: Neutral text stops used on marketing surfaces so body copy stays readable against pale berry.

leaf.description: Success/assurance accent for marketing trust rows (verified, secure, delivered).

paper.description: Pure white for text on a berry action fill and for marketing cards.

surface-accent.description: Secondary berry surface, badges and quiet highlights.

heading.description: Marketing headings on pale berry or white.

on-action.description: Label on a marketing action fill.

text.description: Primary body text on marketing surfaces.

text-secondary.description: Supporting body text on marketing surfaces.
